'''Nullify toxin''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to expel harmful toxins and [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] from their body.
